data.name: Farmstead Market Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Build and manage your own farm and roadside market from the ground up. Grow crops, raise animals, process raw materials, stock your shelves, set prices, hire employees, serve customers, and expand your business.
Start with a small farm and limited equipment. Use your earnings to unlock new land, improve your store, increase storage capacity, and purchase new machines that help you produce more valuable goods.

🌱 Grow and Harvest

Plant different crops and fruit trees. Harvest fresh resources and choose whether to sell them directly or use them in production.

🐄 Raise Animals

Raise chickens, cows, goats, and sheep. Collect products such as eggs, milk, cheese, and meat to support your growing business.

⚙️ Craft New Products

Use production machines to turn raw materials into products such as flour, bread, pasta, sauces, juices, oil, butter, and more.

🛒 Manage Your Market

Place shelves and furniture, organize your products, set and adjust prices, keep the store stocked, and serve customers.

👥 Hire and Manage Employees

Hire employees to help with daily tasks. Assign staff to support your farm and market, improve efficiency, and keep the business running smoothly.

📈 Expand Your Business

Reinvest your earnings into new land, larger storage, store upgrades, better equipment, animals, crops, and additional production machines.
‎ ‎

✨ Key Features

  • Grow crops and fruit trees

  • Raise different farm animals

  • Craft products using machines

  • Build and organize your farm and market

  • Stock shelves and sell products

  • Set and adjust product prices

  • Hire and manage employees

  • Serve visiting customers

  • Upgrade your land, store, and storage

  • Expand from a small farm into a growing business
    ‎ ‎

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3550 / AMD Ryzen 5 2500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS 64-bit / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3550 / AMD Ryzen 5 2500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon R9 270X
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
